meshpool-web.description: Web search, page reading and research without a browser. Built in.

meshpool-assistant.description: Memory across chats, scheduled tasks, past-chat search and parallel sub-agents. Built in.

browser.description: Browser use: the agent opens pages, clicks, types and fills forms in a visible browser window, for sites that need a sign-in or clicks. Built in. Research does not need it.

computer-use.description: Computer use: the agent sees your screen and uses the mouse and keyboard in desktop apps. Built in. Off by default; turn it on when you want the agent to work in an app. On a Mac, allow Screen Recording and Accessibility.

meshpool-tools.description: Time, exact math and project file stats. Built in.

context7.description: Current documentation for code libraries. Online; nothing to install.
